A live version could pull from Portland's CivicClerk portal (portlandme.portal.civicclerk.com) — it exposes an events/agenda feed — or scrape the Agendas & Minutes center (portlandmaine.gov/129/Agendas-Minutes). Map each event's title/body/date/agenda-link into the shape below.

meetings.location: Council Chambers, City Hall, 389 Congress St
meetings.whatItIs: The full nine-member City Council meets to debate and vote on ordinances, the budget, contracts, and appointments.
meetings.whyItMatters: This is where local laws and city spending are actually decided — the final say on most citywide policy.
meetings.howToComment: Speak in person during public comment, or email publiccomment@portlandmaine.gov with your name, legal address, and the agenda order number.
meetings.commentDeadline: Written comments by 12:00 PM on the day of the meeting.

meetings.whatItIs: A council subcommittee that reviews city spending, contracts, and budget items before they reach the full Council.
meetings.whyItMatters: Big financial decisions get shaped here first — it's an early point to weigh in before a full-Council vote.
meetings.howToComment: Email publiccomment@portlandmaine.gov, or sign up to speak at the meeting.
meetings.commentDeadline: Written comments by 12:00 PM the day of the meeting.

meetings.location: Council Chambers, City Hall, 389 Congress St
meetings.whatItIs: Reviews development proposals, site plans, and subdivisions, and holds public hearings on new projects.
meetings.whyItMatters: Decides what actually gets built in your neighborhood — height, density, parking, and design.
meetings.howToComment: Testify at the public hearing, or send written comments to the planning staff before the meeting.
meetings.commentDeadline: Written comments at least 24 hours before the hearing.

meetings.whatItIs: Reviews exterior changes, demolitions, and new construction in the city's historic districts.
meetings.whyItMatters: Shapes what buildings in historic neighborhoods can look like — relevant if you own or live near a landmark property.
meetings.howToComment: Speak at the meeting or submit written comments to preservation staff beforehand.
meetings.commentDeadline: Written comments at least 24 hours before the meeting.

meetings.location: Casco Bay High School, 196 Allen Ave
meetings.whatItIs: The elected school board sets policy and the budget for Portland Public Schools.
meetings.whyItMatters: Decisions on school budgets, staffing, and programs that affect students and families across the district.
meetings.howToComment: Sign up for public comment at the meeting, or email the board through the district office.
meetings.commentDeadline: Sign up before the public comment period opens at the meeting.

meetings.whatItIs: A council subcommittee focused on housing policy, development incentives, and economic programs.
meetings.whyItMatters: Where housing and development policy is drafted before the full Council votes — key for renters and homeowners alike.
meetings.howToComment: Email publiccomment@portlandmaine.gov, or sign up to speak at the meeting.
meetings.commentDeadline: Written comments by 12:00 PM the day of the meeting.
